name: Arnold Open 2018

venue.name: [Fira Barcelona Gran Via](http://www.firabarcelona.com/gran-via)
venue.address: Av. Joan Carles I, 64, 08908 L'Hospitalet de Llobregat

information:
You must get your accreditation the first time you arrive at the competition venue. Please provide us a valid DNI / ID / Passport and type your full name correctly when you complete the [payment](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldOpen2018#7128-payment).

You can check the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldOpen2018#7129-schedule) where you can see all the planning of the competition. Please be very punctual. We recomment to arrive half hour in advance for each event you compete in.
